title: A Chinese model split Silicon Valley. Now the startups are fighting back.

content_html:
Silicon Valley does not usually gang up on its own. This week it did. Nearly 200 US startups have urged the Trump administration not to block American access to Chinese open-weight AI models. A ban, they warn, would gut the next wave of US companies.

The plea, first reported by Politico, came in letters from the newly formed Little Tech Association.

The signatories include Y Combinator and the privacy company Proton. On Wednesday they wrote to President Trump, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, and the White House science chief Michael Kratsios. Their message was blunt. Do not reach for a broad ban. Use targeted safeguards instead.

Why startups want the Chinese models

Open-weight models are those whose weights are published, so anyone can download and run them. Moonshot’s Kimi K3 and Alibaba’s models are cheap, capable, and free to build on.

Cash-strapped founders lean on them rather than pay for credits from Anthropic or OpenAI. A ban, the group argues, would not stop the models spreading. It would just hand the market to a few giants.

“There’ll be hundreds of companies that instantly die,” said Suhail Doshi, founder of the startup Particle and an association member. “It’s great for Anthropic. We’re all going to have to spend money on Anthropic.”

A rare rift with Anthropic

That is the sharp edge of the story. The fight has split the AI industry. Anthropic, with OpenAI, has pushed hardest for curbs on Chinese models, citing security. The startups say bans would do little for security and plenty of harm to competition. The Information reported that the two labs now stand almost alone in the industry.

The Little Tech Association wants precision. “A scalpel rather than a sledgehammer,” its executive director Harry Godfrey said. The aim, he added, is the lightest touch that addresses real security concerns without raising costs or blocking access.

Washington turns up the heat

The revolt follows weeks of escalation. It began after Moonshot released Kimi K3, a model that beat Anthropic’s Fable 5 and OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol on coding tests. Reports then suggested the administration might ban Chinese models outright.

Officials have kept up the pressure. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Fox Business that the US could “sanction” firms that steal American intellectual property.

Kratsios went further. He alleged Moonshot had distilled Anthropic’s Fable model and used banned Nvidia GB300 servers to train K3. Moonshot has not responded. Separately, Commerce’s export-control arm has opened a formal inquiry into whether Chinese firms are getting restricted US chips.

For now, the ban is only talk. A White House official called reports of one “baseless speculation”, and said a blanket ban was not seriously discussed. But the rhetoric is not cooling, and the split it has exposed is real.

The giants want walls. The startups want the door left open. And in Shanghai, Xi Jinping has been pitching cheap, open AI to the rest of the world.

content_html_zh:
硅谷通常不会自行联合起来。 这周确实如此。 近 200 家美国初创公司敦促特朗普政府不要阻止美国使用中国开放权重人工智能模型。 他们警告说，禁令将摧毁下一波美国公司。

这一请求首先由 Politico 报道，来自新成立的小型科技协会 (Little Tech Association) 的信函。

签署方包括 Y Combinator 和隐私公司 Proton。 周三，他们写信给特朗普总统、商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克和白宫科学主管迈克尔·克拉西奥斯。 他们的信息很直率。 不要寻求广泛的禁令。 请改用有针对性的保障措施。

为什么初创公司想要中国模式

开放权重模型是指权重已发布的模型，因此任何人都可以下载并运行它们。 Moonshot 的 Kimi K3 和阿里巴巴的型号价格便宜、功能强大，并且可以免费构建。

资金短缺的创始人依赖它们，而不是支付 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 的积分。 该组织认为，禁令不会阻止这些模型的传播。 它只会将市场交给少数巨头。

“将会有数百家公司立即消亡，”初创公司 Particle 的创始人、协会成员苏海尔·多西 (Suhail Doshi) 说。 “这对 Anthropic 来说非常棒。 我们都得在 Anthropic 上花钱。”

与人类的罕见裂痕

这就是故事的尖锐之处。 这场斗争已经分裂了人工智能行业。 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 一起以安全为由，极力推动对中国模型的限制。 这些初创公司表示，禁令对安全没有多大帮助，而且会对竞争造成很大损害。 据《The Information》报道，这两个实验室现在在业内几乎是独一无二的。

小科技协会想要精确。 “它是一把手术刀，而不是一把大锤，”其执行董事哈里戈弗雷说。 他补充说，目标是在不增加成本或阻止访问的情况下，以最轻松的方式解决真正的安全问题。

华盛顿升温

叛乱持续数周升级。 它始于 Moonshot 发布 Kimi K3，该模型在编码测试中击败了 Anthropic 的 Fable 5 和 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Sol。 随后有报道称，政府可能会彻底禁止中国车型。

官员们一直在施加压力。 财政部长斯科特·贝森特在福克斯商业频道上表示，美国可以“制裁”窃取美国知识产权的公司。

克拉齐奥斯走得更远。 他声称 Moonshot 提炼了 Anthropic 的 Fable 模型，并使用被禁用的 Nvidia GB300 服务器来训练 K3。 月射尚未回应。 另外，商务部出口管制部门已对中国企业是否获得受限制的美国芯片展开正式调查。

目前，该禁令还只是说说而已。 一名白宫官员称有关报道是“毫无根据的猜测”，并表示并未认真讨论全面禁令。 但言辞并没有冷却，它所暴露的分裂是真实的。

巨人想要围墙。 初创公司希望大门敞开。 在上海，习近平一直在向世界其他地区推销廉价、开放的人工智能。
